headline: 4 die while rescuing goat from septic tank in Tangail
summary: A father, his son, and two others lost their lives after entering an abandoned pit in Madhupur Upazila.
details: Four people, including a father and his son, died after entering an abandoned septic tank in Tangail's Madhupur Upazila.
The tragedy occurred around 8:30 am on Saturday at Telikirjalai while the group was attempting to retrieve a goat that had fallen into the pit.
Madhupur Police chief AKM Fazlul Haque confirmed the incident, noting that the victims entered the abandoned structure to save the animal.
caption:
A rescue mission for a goat turned fatal in Tangail, claiming the lives of four people, including a father and son.

Four people, including a father and his son, died after entering an abandoned septic tank in Tangail's Madhupur Upazila.

The tragedy occurred around 8:30 am on Saturday at Telikirjalai while the group was attempting to retrieve a goat that had fallen into the pit.

Madhupur Police chief AKM Fazlul Haque confirmed the incident, noting that the victims entered the abandoned structure to save the animal.

headline_marked: Brazil beats Haiti 3-0: [[Fans flood Dhaka University's TSC]] in celebration
headline: Brazil beats Haiti 3-0: Fans flood Dhaka University's TSC in celebration
summary: Thousands of supporters gathered at TSC Payra Chattar to watch the match on a big screen, celebrating Brazil's first World Cup win of the campaign.
details: Brazil secured their first victory of the current World Cup campaign by defeating Haiti 3-0 in their Group C match.
In Dhaka, thousands of fans gathered early Saturday morning at the University of Dhaka's TSC Payra Chattar to watch the game on a big screen.
The atmosphere was electric as supporters erupted in joy following the win, with many wearing the iconic yellow and green jerseys.
Celebrations extended beyond the university campus, with fans at Daffodil University also celebrating the victory by lighting flares.
Some supporters took their enthusiasm to the skies, using a drone to fly the Brazilian flag over the crowds.
The victory was also celebrated by members of the showbiz community, adding to the festive mood across the city.
caption:
Thousands of Brazil fans take over Dhaka University's TSC to celebrate a 3-0 victory over Haiti!

Brazil secured their first victory of the current World Cup campaign by defeating Haiti 3-0 in their Group C match.

In Dhaka, thousands of fans gathered early Saturday morning at the University of Dhaka's TSC Payra Chattar to watch the game on a big screen.

The atmosphere was electric as supporters erupted in joy following the win, with many wearing the iconic yellow and green jerseys.

Celebrations extended beyond the university campus, with fans at Daffodil University also celebrating the victory by lighting flares.

Some supporters took their enthusiasm to the skies, using a drone to fly the Brazilian flag over the crowds.

The victory was also celebrated by members of the showbiz community, adding to the festive mood across the city.
